name: DOCS_RCVD_COM_RESRC_USAGE
description: Contains information about a member/patient's community resource usages, as received from an outside organization over Care Everywhere or Payer Platform.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the document record.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE_REAL
columns.description: A unique contact date in decimal format. The integer portion of the number indicates the date of contact. The digits after the decimal distinguish different contacts on the same date and are unique for each contact on that date. For example, .00 is the first/only contact, .01 is the second contact, etc.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this contact. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this contact.

columns.name: CONTACT_DATE
columns.description: The date of this contact in calendar format.

columns.name: COMM_RESRC_USAGE_REF_IDENT
columns.description: This column stores the unique reference ID of a discrete community resource usage.

columns.name: COMM_RESRC_USAGE_STATUS_C_NAME
columns.description: Stores the status of if a member/patient is currently using this community resource.

columns.name: COMM_RESRC_REQ_STATUS_C_NAME
columns.description: This column stores the request status. The request status answers the question of "was the request to use this community resource sent to that community resource and did they receive it, did it get canceled, etc.?"

columns.name: COMM_RESRC_STREET_ADDR
columns.description: This column stores the street address of the community resource being used.

columns.name: COMM_RESRC_COUNTY_C_NAME
columns.description: This column stores the county for the community resource being used.

columns.name: COMM_RESRC_CITY
columns.description: This column stores the city of the community resource being used.

columns.name: COMM_RESRC_ADDR_STATE_C_NAME
columns.description: This column stores the state of the community resource being used.

columns.name: COMM_RESRC_POSTAL_CODE
columns.description: This column stores the postal code of the community resource being used.

columns.name: COMM_RESRC_COUNTRY_C_NAME
columns.description: This column stores the country of the community resource being used.

columns.name: COMM_RESRC_REFERRED_UTC_DTTM
columns.description: Stores the instant that the community resource was first documented or referred to the member or patient.
